title: Asyntai AI Assistant
description: Settings for the Asyntai AI Assistant panel.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Your Asyntai API key. Get it at https://asyntai.com/settings/api/

websiteId.title: Website ID
websiteId.description: The website whose knowledge base the panel asks. The panel sets this when you pick a website. Empty means your primary website.

apiBaseUrl.title: API address
apiBaseUrl.description: The address of the Asyntai API. Keep the default.
